suite: Security scans QA NXT runs itself
objective: The engine and the platform agree on what the severity and confidence words mean
preconditions: the engine source and the platform's enums
input: SEVERITY_ORDER and CONFIDENCE_ORDER against SecuritySeverity and SecurityConfidence
expected: Identical names in identical order. The worker sends a number and the platform reads an enum; if the two orderings ever diverge, every finding in transit is silently reclassified and nothing fails
detail: 5 severity band(s) and 3 confidence level(s) agree
